episodes.synopsis: After a poor childhood, Hajime grew up and made a living as an adventurer. But then he meets another orphan...
episodes.title: A Single Man and a Little Girl Meet

episodes.synopsis: An acquaintance of Hajime's comes to verify Rirui's identity, but may have even more in mind.
episodes.title: Rirui's Talent

episodes.synopsis: Rirui makes friends with an aspiring young dwarf craftswoman, Anyango.
episodes.title: Rirui and Anyango

episodes.synopsis: Hajime and Rirui explore a dungeon that's due for demolition before meeting a new acquaintance.
episodes.title: First Love's Outcome

episodes.synopsis: Will Rirui's egg hatch before Hajime turns it into breakfast?
episodes.title: What's Hatching

episodes.synopsis: Veronica invites Hajime and Rirui to the city of Yanago to help her with some business trouble.

episodes.synopsis: A beaster scholar and his daughter enlist Hajime and Rirui's help, but sparks fly between the two kids.
episodes.title: Rirui and Cocko

episodes.title: A Resident of the Village

episodes.title: After the Battle

episodes.title: A Haircut and a Decision

episodes.title: The Power of Charm

episodes.synopsis: Rirui's Charm power is activating while she sleeps, attracting monsters and leaving Hajime at a loss.
episodes.title: Hometowns and Friends
